test_cases.prompt: Our SaaS startup is at $2M ARR with 4 engineers. Should we pursue aggressive growth ($500K fundraising, 5x target in 18 months) or lean profitability (2.5x in 3 years, full control)? Market window is narrowing with new competitors entering.
test_cases.expected_output: Clear recommendation with analysis of both paths

test_cases.name: api-specification
test_cases.prompt: Complete this authentication API spec: 'POST /auth/login accepts email and password, returns a token if successful. Must handle invalid credentials, expired tokens, and rate limiting. Should work with both desktop and mobile clients.' Fill all gaps: status codes, error formats, rate limit rules, token expiration, concurrent sessions, security, monitoring, backwards compatibility.
test_cases.expected_output: Exhaustive specification addressing all gaps with internal consistency

test_cases.name: code-debugging
test_cases.prompt: Production crash in Python upload handler: 'NoneType has no attribute length' error occurs 0.3% of the time (150 failures/day from 50K uploads). Function reads file, validates it, processes it. Validation sometimes returns None instead of raising error. Critical path, expensive downtime. One engineer, one week available. What's the fix?
test_cases.expected_output: Root cause analysis, immediate mitigation, and long-term solution
